question: Should OpenClaw keep ambiguous outbound rows pending when no adapter can reconcile them, after fixing the no-op replay-pacing bug?
rationale: This changes existing upgrade behavior from terminalizing ambiguous rows to retaining them for future reconciliation, which is a message-delivery and operator-visibility tradeoff rather than a purely local code cleanup.

options.title: Fix pacing, then accept pending deferral
options.body: Repair the no-op pacer/deadline regression and keep the PR's recoverable pending-row behavior as the preferred mitigation until the broader delivery ledger lands.

options.title: Keep fail-fast behavior for now
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failure behavior until a complete reconciler/operator surface is ready.

options.title: Fold into the broader ledger work
options.body: Defer this mitigation into the canonical transcript-to-client delivery consistency design so state, UI, and reconciliation semantics land together.

recommendation.title: Fix pacing, then accept pending deferral
recommendation.body: Repair the no-op pacer/deadline regression and keep the PR's recoverable pending-row behavior as the preferred mitigation until the broader delivery ledger lands.
